summary.name: A Working Theory-of-Monitoring
summary.one_liner: A LISA 2013 conference talk by Google SRE Caskey Dickson presenting a formal model for evaluating monitoring systems and how open source tools fit it.
use_cases: Evaluating monitoring systems for large-scale operations
Learning a formal framework for designing monitoring
Comparing open source monitoring tools against a theoretical model
Identifying blind spots in existing monitoring
summary.what_it_does: The page is the abstract and speaker bio for a USENIX LISA 2013 talk. Google SRE Caskey Dickson describes a formal model Google uses to develop, evaluate and evolve its internal monitoring systems. The talk states it covers common monitoring pitfalls and false simplifications that cause blind spots. It says the model will be compared with how existing open source monitoring solutions fit or fail to fit it. The page does not describe any software tool or its concrete features.
notable: Presents a formal monitoring model used internally at Google
Speaker is a Google Site Reliability Engineer
Maps open source monitoring solutions against the model
caveats: Page is a talk abstract, not a software product; no tool is described
Model details are not given in the page text
